stage1.impression: Clear, on-concept idea (violet speaker as the vanishing point of lavender rows at dusk), but the lighting undermines it: washed near-white pink sky and pale sun disc, lavender flat and evenly lit with no warm rim from the low sun, the speaker a dark box with no glow through its acrylic, a studio-clean glossy pink horn, and a flat beige horizon band cutting exactly at the horn/cabinet junction. Reads as a good CG render, not a photograph.

blocking_9: low sun must visibly light the scene (warm rims on lavender and speaker edges, an orange disc and glow)
acrylic glows from behind: cabinet median above ~55
hills read as separate ranges receding into violet haze, not one beige band
horizon must not cross the horn/cabinet joint
path soil with clods, pebbles, dry stems, ruts
nothing cropped at the frame edge (the lone tree)

change.setting: light on the sun's axis behind the speaker; reflector

change.to: 35 mm, clods and pebbles 5-40 mm, dry clippings, faint ruts
